title: Data Engineer
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de uma pessoa Data Engineer para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas brasileiros. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!

O profissional será responsável por transformar dados complexos em informações estratégicas. Construir pipelines robustos e escaláveis, garantindo a qualidade e a segurança das informações. E gerar insights que apoiarão a tomada de decisões em várias áreas da empresa, incluindo finanças, clientes e software.


Escopo e responsabilidades

  • Construção de Pipelines (ETL/ELT): Desenvolver e monitorar pipelines escaláveis utilizando Python e ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Suporte ao BI e Analytics: Estruturar visões no Metabase para consultas rápidas e gerenciar a exploração de dados complexos via Looker.
  • Otimização de Performance: Escrever queries SQL avançadas e otimizar o consumo de dados das ferramentas de visualização para reduzir custos e tempo de resposta.
  • Qualidade de Dados: Implementar testes e monitoramento para garantir que as métricas no Looker e Metabase estejam sempre íntegras.



Requisitos Técnicos

  • Python: Experiência em automação, integração de APIs e bibliotecas de manipulação de dados.
  • SQL Avançado: Domínio absoluto de SQL para transformações complexas e otimização de bancos analíticos.
  • Looker: Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de modelos, dimensões, medidas e gerenciamento de projetos dentro do Looker.
  • Metabase: Capacidade de configurar dashboards e perguntas via interface e SQL.
  • Pipelines de Dados: Vivência com orquestradores (Airflow, dbt ou similares).
  • Cloud Data Warehouse: Conhecimento em BigQuery.


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Engenheira de Dados Sênior e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora

title: Analista de Engenharia de Custos SR
description:
Desafio da Área e da Posição:



✅Realizar os estudos e orçamentos dos investimentos, através do desenvolvimento, entendimento e análise crítica dos entregáveis

✅Realizar avaliações de viabilidade econômico-financeiras de soluções e projetos, através do desenvolvimento, entendimento e análise crítica dos entregáveis

✅Elaborar o planejamento plurianual das concessionárias (quinquenal) além do levantamento das necessidades de investimentos (contratuais e não contratuais) e da elaboração/ atualização de orçamento das obras não contratadas.

✅Analisar os impactos financeiros gerados pelas mudanças de projeto, serviços não previstos e reivindicação de despesas dos empreendimentos, através da análise técnica na verificação dos quantitativos, preços novos e aderência ao contrato

✅Desenvolver junto às Unidades de Negócio/ Divisões as negociações relativas a engenharia de custos junto ao Poder Concedente, através do entendimento e análise crítica dos orçamentos dos investimentos extra contratuais ou oportunidades dos investimentos contratuais e elaboração das respostas e justificativas técnicas, quando necessário, ou com a participação em reuniões técnicas com as Agências

✅Atuar de forma integrada com as demais áreas da concessionaria , visando a integração de competências, em busca das alternativas de projetos que geram valor ao negócio, desenvolvendo a estruturação das engenharias de valores através da análise crítica das lições registradas além de contribuir com a identificação e registro

✅Atuar de forma integrada com Suprimentos, acompanhando os resultados das solicitações com o objetivo de trazer aos projetos em estudo a solução mais econômica



Requisitos e qualificações


O que esperamos de você:

✅ Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Civil/produção;

✅ Experiência em orçamento de obras;

✅ Domínio nas ferramentas do Pacote Office (Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook);

✅Conhecimento em tabelas públicas como SICRO, SINAPI, TPU DER/SP


Você se destaca, se tiver:


✅ Especialização / Pós-Graduação em Gestão de Projetos ou Engenharia de Custos;

✅ Habilitação CNH “B” – Disponibilidade para viagens;

✅ Conhecimento em Power Bi;

✅ Conhecimento em Compor90;

title: Chef Tournant
description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
  • Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
  • Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
  • Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
  • Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
  • Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
  • Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
  • Responsible for follow-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
  • Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
  • Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
  • Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
  • Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within his section.
  • Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
  • Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food & Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
  • Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.


QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION

  • A minimum of 5 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef Tournant (shipboard experience preferred).
  • A culinary school degree is required.
  • Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
  • Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
  • Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
  • Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
  • Intermediate computer software skills required.
  • Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries and corrections.
  • Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

title: Calypso Configuration and Environment Management
description:
Why Luxoft?


Luxoft has one of the world's leading Calypso practice.

We are a top-tier Calypso Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade, and migration.

We provide end-to-end project services and have delivered Calypso projects across all major asset classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury, and insurance.


Our benefits:

  • Comprehensive health & dental insurance (Amil, fully paid, incl. dependents)
  • Remote / home office allowance (monthly)
  • Meal voucher
  • Transportation voucher
  • Childcare / family allowance
  • Savings plan (FGTS)
  • Life & mandatory insurance (fully covered)
  • Profit sharing program


Project Description:

Support and additional build out for a greenfield Calypso instance.


Responsibilities:


- Develop necessary technical solutions for Calypso environments and instance on the cloud as per requirements

- Resolve Calypso environment related issues

- Stabilize Calypso environment with improvements and other services architectural changes

- Establish a comprehensive and integrated approach to defining, setting up, or trouble shooting issues arising from day-to-day activities on greenfield Calypso instance

- Create and deliver assigned projects / tasks and revise as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements

- Competent in managing and establishing methodology and best practice for Calypso technical requirements

- Ensures supporting documents are complete, current, and appropriately stored

- Works closely with relevant business and technology stakeholders to ensure effective and efficient implementation of the project(s)

- Submits status reports to stakeholders; coordinates and provides updates to steering committees

- Collaboration with key functional or business stakeholders to achieve clear outcomes/deliverables in relation to the strategic and transformational book of work

- Manage deliverables ensuring transparency of risks, issues and dependencies that are fully aligned to functional / business owners


You might be acting also as a business analyst as well in order to help the team gathering and writing requirements, acceptance criteria.


Mandatory Skills:

• 5+ years of experience working in Capital Markets and Calypso

• Environment management, support, and optimization experience on Calypso

• Good knowledge of Financial products cross assets

• Proven track record of delivery of implementation / migration projects

• Proven experience in the development of Calypso integrations, reporting, and other technical aspects

- Experience of adherence to governance frameworks / implementation and handover to BAU

• Comprehensive knowledge of trade flow, trading systems and related concepts and technology, including valuation and client/market risk management

• Leadership skills

• Excellent analytical skills, understanding of project life cycles, and ability to act in an entrepreneurial manner to ensure the requirements from the business are gathered in the appropriate manner.

• Proven analytical, planning, problem solving and decision-making skills

• Comfortable with direct communication with all levels of technical and business resources

• Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously

• Experience with working in a highly collaborative and dynamic multi-team environment


Nice-to-Have Skills:

• Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment is essential.

• Have a willingness to learn new skills

• Must have attention to detail

• Must have the ability to work independently and also as part of a group


• Experience of Agile practices and processes (e.g. SCRUM, KANBAN)

• Any technical knowledge (Writing simple sql query, be able to read code )

• Conflict management ensuring collaborative outcomes

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy


Languages:

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

Spanish: C2 Proficient


Luxoft is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

We show fairness to all throughout our talent acquisition and management process.

title: Engenheiro de Software Sênior PJ (Ruby on Rails)
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.700 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


Modelo de contratação PJ.


O Engenheiro de Software Sênior Backend (Ruby on Rails) será responsável por:

  • Participar ativamente das etapas de desenvolvimento e entrega de funcionalidades;
  • Compreender rapidamente o domínio do projeto e o funcionamento da aplicação;
  • Propor e implementar soluções de forma autônoma, colaborando com o time em decisões técnicas;
  • Garantir a qualidade do código com testes automatizados e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de produto, design e outras áreas técnicas.


Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • Experiência sólida (5+ anos) com Ruby on Rails em produção;
  • Proficiência com ActiveRecord, Sidekiq, RSpec, Devise e outras gems amplamente utilizadas;
  • Domínio de banco de dados relacional (preferencialmente PostgreSQL);
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful;
  • Conhecimento em Docker e versionamento com Git;
  • Capacidade de navegação e evolução em bases de código existentes;
  • Escrita de código limpo, testável e de fácil manutenção.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Hotwire/Turbo;
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD (ex: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI);
  • Familiaridade com integração a serviços externos (ex: Stripe, AWS, SendGrid);
  • Fluência em ambientes ágeis com squads enxutos.

Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.700 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. title: Data Analyst
description:
Título do Cargo: Analista de Dados

Nível: 4 ou 5

O que você fará:

  • Ter mentalidade de crescimento, identificando desafios e oportunidades de negócio e resolvendo-os por meio de análise e mineração de dados.
  • Apoiar análises e fornecer insights sobre uso de produto, performance de campanhas, métricas de funil, segmentação, conversão e crescimento de receita.
  • Desenvolver análises ad-hoc, projetos de longo prazo, relatórios e dashboards para gerar novos insights e medir o progresso das iniciativas-chave.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com stakeholders para entender necessidades analíticas, métricas críticas e KPIs.
  • Colaborar com diferentes times da organização para compreender requisitos e necessidades de negócio.
  • Criar e apresentar análises que traduzam problemas complexos em insights claros e acionáveis.


Requisitos Mínimos:

  • Graduação ou nível superior em área quantitativa.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em funções de análise de dados.
  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência com Python, SQL e ferramentas de visualização como Tableau, Looker ou Power BI.
  • Histórico comprovado de tomada de decisão e resolução de problemas baseada em dados.
  • Forte visão de negócio, liderança e integridade.
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal, com habilidade de influência estratégica e negociação.
  • Perfil proativo, adaptável e confortável em ambientes dinâmicos.
  • Forte domínio de ferramentas de BI e Excel (Power BI é um diferencial).


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com técnicas de mineração de dados, incluindo aprendizado supervisionado e não supervisionado.
  • Vivência com AWS e programação em Spark/PySpark.
  • Conhecimento em Airflow para orquestração de workflows.
  • Background em marketing digital, vendas e/ou estratégia.
  • Capacidade de colaborar de forma eficaz em ambientes multifuncionais e matriciais.

Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $800 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,600 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory

  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Analista de desenvolvimento de software SR
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

O dia a dia:

  • Disseminar conhecimento e documentar decisões técnicas, por meio da criação de documentos ou registros no sistema de gestão.
  • Promover boas práticas de desenvolvimento, qualidade de código e testes automatizados, por meio de capacitações, compartilhamento de informações e registros.
  • Identificar e remover bloqueios que impactem as entregas do time.
  • Realizar revisão de código e de decisões técnicas, garantindo estabilidade, qualidade e aderência aos padrões da empresa.
  • Contribuir com os Coordenadores de Produto na definição de roadmap e na estratégia do time, considerando aspectos técnicos.
  • Apoiar outros times de Engenharia, garantindo que grandes lançamentos e mudanças tecnológicas ocorram de forma segura, minimizando impactos.
  • Participar da definição de projetos e tarefas, avaliando arquitetura, impactos, estratégias de deploy e entregáveis.
  • Desenvolver pipelines de Integração Contínua (CI).
  • Estruturar monitoramento, alarmes e ferramentas de troubleshooting.
  • Avaliar trade-offs, riscos e impactos para subsidiar decisões técnicas.
  • Desdobrar projetos complexos em entregas menores, executáveis por si ou pelo time.
  • Trazer visibilidade sobre débitos técnicos e riscos, propondo priorizações para mitigação.
  • Investigar e atuar em incidentes de produção, liderando a análise e correção da causa raiz.
  • Antecipar impactos de mudanças e novos produtos na arquitetura existente, propondo ações de mitigação.
  • Definir, discutir e documentar padrões de código, práticas de qualidade e estratégias de testes.
  • Identificar e mitigar riscos de segurança nos sistemas.
  • Apoiar a liderança imediata na análise de problemas e definição de ações, contribuindo para a melhoria dos processos.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento de normas e procedimentos da área, identificando e sugerindo melhorias.
  • Analisar processos e propor melhorias que contribuam para a eficiência e os resultados da área.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências e inovações tecnológicas, promovendo a melhoria contínua.
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas, conforme orientação da liderança.


Requisitos e qualificações

Para essa posição, esperamos que você tenha:

  • Experiência prática com Datadog para monitoramento de aplicações, análise de logs e construção de dashboards.
  • Conhecimento em OpenTelemetry para instrumentação de serviços e geração de métricas, traces e logs.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de observabilidade em ambientes distribuídos, como definição de SLOs, criação de alertas, análise de causa raiz e correlação de eventos.
  • Vivência com arquitetura baseada em microsserviços, uso de mensageria (como Kafka ou RabbitMQ) e integração com sistemas legados ou de terceiros.
  • Capacidade de desenhar soluções escaláveis, resilientes e observáveis.
  • Experiência sólida com TypeScript e Node.js no desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços backend.
  • Proficiência no uso do framework NestJS, incluindo conceitos como injeção de dependência, interceptors, pipes, guards e modules.
  • Experiência na criação e manutenção de APIs REST, seguindo boas práticas de versionamento, documentação e segurança.


Informações adicionais

title: Manager, Site Strategy & Engagement
description:
Established in 1996 and rebranded to Scout in 2024, we built our foundation on planning meetings for numerous organizations within the life sciences sector (Scout Meetings). In response to emerging industry needs, we expanded our services to include Scout Clinical, one of the top providers of clinical trial patient travel and reimbursements, and Scout Academy, our secure, online, on-demand learning management system that ensures global compliance.


Scout is recognized as a leader in our field for innovation in service, attention to detail, our stellar team members, and making the complex easier. If this interests you, we’d love to have you join our rapidly growing team!


Position Summary:

The Manager of Site Strategy and Engagement is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with clinical research sites, ensuring successful site engagement, and performance throughout the clinical trial lifecycle. This role involves collaborating with clinical operations teams, ensuring the utilization of the services scoped, and working to enhance site satisfaction and operational efficiency.


Responsibilities of this position include but are not limited to:

  • Site Engagement: Identify, assess, and engage with potential clinical research sites in studies contracted to use Scout services, ensuring they are aware of the service and have everything needed to optimize use of the portal.
  • Site Support: Provide guidance and direction to sites and operations team members to drive strategy for continued use of the portal.
  • Site/Study Utilization Monitoring: Monitor site utilization throughout the trial, ensuring portal use and proactively addressing any issues or concerns that may arise at the site level.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Project Managers, Patient Lesions, Site staff, and sponsors, to ensure alignment on site-related needs.
  • Site Relationship Management: Cultivate long-term, productive relationships with clinical sites. Regularly check in with sites to assess their needs, gather feedback, and improve site engagement strategies.
  • Problem Solving & Issue Resolution: Anticipate, identify, and resolve any issues or obstacles at the site level to ensure continued use of the portal.
  • Regional Client Support: Support client conversations with regional specific expertise. Gather local market insights including challenges and recommend how Scout can best support or solve them.
  • Marketing for the region: Support marketing with drafting messaging with an emphasis on local, cultural, economic and regulatory considerations.
  • Complete all required initial and ongoing training within a reasonable or provided timeframe.


The ideal candidate will have the following experience, skills, and knowledge:

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in clinical research or clinical trial management, with a focus on site management or clinical site engagement.
  • Strong understanding of clinical trial processes, regulations, and industry best practices.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to build rapport with diverse stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple sites and projects simultaneously, with strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese (spoken and written)


Visit our website at or follow us on LinkedIn for other employment opportunities.


WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform): Hands-on experience with BTP services, particularly in application development and deployment

UI/UX Design: Experience creating responsive and user-friendly applications

OData Services: Proficient in consuming and integrating OData services; knowledge of SAP Gateway

Development Tools: SAP Business Application Studio (BAS), SAP Web IDE, Git

Version Control & CI/CD: Familiar with GitHub/GitLab, Jenkins, or other CI/CD pipelines

Performance Optimization: Ability to optimize UI5 apps for performance and scalability

Experience with CAP (Cloud Application Programming) Model on SAP BTP

Exposure to Node.js, REST APIs, or microservices architecture

Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies

Understanding of security concepts (authentication, authorization in SAP BTP)

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

ID:

title: Software Engineer
description:
Salary: $3000 - $3500 / month

Location: Remote

Working Hours: Brazil Time

Employment Type: Full-Time



About the Role

As a Software Engineer, you’ll build internal tools, automations, and dashboards that eliminate bottlenecks and drive serious ROI for fast-growing businesses.


We’re an AI-driven engineering team. You’ll be using AI tools heavily to speed up development. Your job isn’t to write every line from scratch — it’s to guide the AI, review its output, and make sure everything that ships is clean, scalable, and production-ready. AI can write code, but only a human can exercise strong judgment around architecture, performance, and long-term maintainability.


You’ll own your projects end-to-end and see exactly how your work impacts real businesses — not in theory, but through direct feedback and measurable results. The tools you build will help 7- and 8- figure companies grow faster and save +$100K in expenses. If you want to sharpen your skills, make meaningful technical decisions, and be part of where software engineering is headed in the age of AI — this is the role.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build custom internal tools and AI-driven applications that eliminate manual work
  • Build and maintain REST APIs, backend servers, and databases
  • Develop primarily with custom code (Python), using no-code platforms (Make, Airtable) where they make architectural sense
  • Create dashboards that give C-suite visibility into key business metrics


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of professional backend software engineering experience (Python preferred), including shipping and maintaining production systems
  • Experience building REST APIs and production-grade servers
  • Experience making and defending technical decisions (e.g. database design, API structure, performance vs speed tradeoffs)
  • Designing and implementing databases (SQL or No-SQL)
  • Fluent English — written and spoken


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with No-Code Automation Tools like Make, Zapier, N8N
  • Experience setting up project management tools like AirTable, Monday.com, or Asana


Why Join Us?

  • Get hands-on experience building solutions at the bleeding edge of AI + automation
  • Work directly with founders and see how multi-7 and 8-figure businesses actually run
  • Build a portfolio of systems that save companies $100K+ per year


Please Note: This role is not a pure no-code or automation-only position. Strong software engineering fundamentals are required.

  • Monitor and remediate security compliance results from tool like Nessus/Tenable
  • Perform VMware crash/error analysis, Root Cause Analysis, Coordinate Post Problem Analysis and Trend Analysis
  • Basic Linux administration
  • On-call support

title: 销售工程师
description:
Company Overview

Renepoly (Official Website: ) is a provider of smart microgrid and energy storage solutions in the new energy industry. Our products cover commercial & industrial energy storage and utility-scale energy storage systems, coupled with a self-developed Energy Management System (EMS). We are committed to delivering one-stop clean energy project services for governments, industrial parks, commercial complexes and new energy enterprises.


Equipped with our own manufacturing facility, we boast a solid track record of project delivery, a diversified resource network, as well as an experienced R&D and after-sales team. We have successfully implemented multiple megawatt-scale energy storage and microgrid demonstration projects, with our business scope covering smart energy management, grid peak-shaving, renewable energy grid integration and other fields.


Job Description:

1. Responsible for sales of energy products in Brazil and surrounding markets.

2. Develop new clients, maintain existing relationships, and drive order closures.

3. Manage local warehouse operations and perform basic inventory management.

4. Accompany clients to project sites/warehouse for equipment demonstrations and conduct customer visits.

5. Proactively identify potential clients and expand market share in the new energy storage sector.


Requirements:

1. Bachelor’s degree or above, with 5+ years of sales experience in new energy, electrical, EPC, PV, or energy storage.

2. Background in new energy vehicles, equipment, or engineering industries.

3. Fluency in Spanish and Portuguese, and English.

4. Ability to independently develop clients and execute sales tasks with a proactive approach.

6. Experience in warehouse or inventory management is a plus.

7. Update the progress of customer follow-up weekly.

8. Hold regular business progress reporting meetings with the Director of Foreign Trade and the General Manager of the Americas every two weeks.



Join us and share the green-economy opportunity!

We are committed to delivering one-stop clean energy project services for governments, industrial parks, commercial complexes and new energy enterprises.


Equipped with our own manufacturing facility, we boast a solid track record of project delivery, a diversified resource network, as well as an experienced R&D and after-sales team. We have successfully implemented multiple megawatt-scale energy storage and microgrid demonstration projects, with our business scope covering smart energy management, grid peak-shaving, renewable energy grid integration and other fields.


Job Description:

1. Responsible for sales of energy products in Brazil and surrounding markets.

2. Develop new clients, maintain existing relationships, and drive order closures.

3. Manage local warehouse operations and perform basic inventory management.

4. Accompany clients to project sites/warehouse for equipment demonstrations and conduct customer visits.

5. Proactively identify potential clients and expand market share in the new energy storage sector.


Requirements:

1. Bachelor’s degree or above, with 5+ years of sales experience in new energy, electrical, EPC, PV, or energy storage.

2. Background in new energy vehicles, equipment, or engineering industries.

3. Fluency in Spanish and Portuguese, and English.

4. Ability to independently develop clients and execute sales tasks with a proactive approach.

6. Experience in warehouse or inventory management is a plus.

7. Update the progress of customer follow-up weekly.

8. Hold regular business progress reporting meetings with the Director of Foreign Trade and the General Manager of the Americas every two weeks.



Join us and share the green-economy opportunity!

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
About Us

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


About Your Team

At Teachable, our Data team aims to support company data-driven decision-making. Reporting to the Head of Data, you will collaborate with business and product teams to validate hypotheses, answer complex business questions, help the company in uncertain scenarios, perform data experiments, and disseminate actionable insights.


About You

You will take the lead in exploring data and cross-business variables, uncovering patterns and trends, identifying new data sources, and delivering valuable insights to various departments.


What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and execute complex data analyses using statistical techniques and modeling to validate business hypotheses.
  • Detect patterns, trends and anomalies in data and translate them into actionable insights that drive strategic decisions and business growth.
  • Serve as a key expert in data analysis, providing guidance and best practices to team members and stakeholders across the company.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of experience within data analytics and/or data science.
  • Strong curiosity for uncovering insights from data.
  • Proven experience in delivering data studies focused on generating and sharing actionable data.
  • Deep understanding of statistical methods, including hypothesis testing and statistical modeling.
  • Proficiency in SQL for extracting data directly from source systems.
  • Sharp critical thinking and analytical problem-solving abilities.
  • Enjoy working in a dynamic environment with fast learning and deliveries.
  • Advanced English proficiency (conversational, listening, writing.)


Nice to Have:

  • Ability to perform data cleaning and processing steps using Python or R languages.
  • Hands-on experience in building Machine Learning models.


This is a fully remote role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil. Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time, and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

description:
Atividades:

• Atrair, identificar e triar profissionais por meio da busca ativa nas ferramentas de recrutamento, que atendam aos requisitos técnicos e comportamentais das vagas abertas;

• Estabelecer contato com os candidatos, para apresentar a empresa, os benefícios da posição e os desafios envolvidos no trabalho, promovendo o interesse desses candidatos em participar do processo seletivo;

• Preparar o resumo do candidato com currículo e parecer de entrevista para envio ao Comercial/Cliente;

• Conduzir entrevistas, aplicar testes ou outras técnicas de avaliação, quando necessário;

• Levantar informações sobre a experiência e as referências profissionais dos candidatos para avaliar seu histórico de desempenho e verificar sua aderência frente à cultura e valores da empresa;

• Utilizar habilidades de negociação para identificar as expectativas e necessidades do candidato em relação a sua posição atual e à oferta da empresa;

• Apresentar de forma clara os benefícios da vaga, incluindo possibilidades de desenvolvimento profissional, desafios e oportunidades de crescimento.

• Agendar e participar de entrevistas com clientes, realizar propostas, entre outras atividades.


Requisitos da vaga:

• Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Psicologia, Gestão de RH e áreas afins;

• Excelente comunicação oral e escrita;

• Experiência em vagas de tecnologia ou atuação prévia em consultoria de R&S com foco em TI;

• Familiaridade com vocabulário técnico;

• Habilidades desenvolvidas de persuasão, engajamento e empatia.

• Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Maringá/PR.

title: Exchange Administrator
description:
About the Role:

Our client is looking for an experienced professional with a strong focus on the administration and support of Microsoft solutions. The ideal candidate will have solid experience managing corporate environments and working with mission-critical technologies that ensure business continuity. This role requires availability to participate in an on-call rotation and the ability to communicate in English with global teams. The position is offered under a contractor model.


Responsibilities:

  • Administer and maintain Exchange 2016 and Office 365 environments, ensuring platform availability, stability, and performance.
  • Manage and optimize Active Directory environments, including security policies, authentication, and organizational structures.
  • Create, review, and automate processes using PowerShell to increase efficiency and operational control.
  • Provide advanced-level technical support and troubleshooting, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, system migrations, and upgrades.
  • Be available to participate in an on-call rotation schedule, responding to incidents and critical issues as needed.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience with Exchange 2016, including maintenance, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong experience with Office 365, focusing on identity administration, licensing, and end-user support.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Active Directory, including DNS, Group Policies (GPOs), and authentication.
  • Advanced PowerShell skills, with the ability to build and maintain scripts for automation and problem resolution.
  • Conversational English is required, as the role involves interaction with international teams and stakeholders.

title: Data Scientist  [Modelos Clássicos] - [Banco de Talentos]
description:
Estamos formando um Banco de Talentos para profissionais de Data Science com especialização em Métodos Clássicos .

O objetivo é identificar talentos para futuras oportunidades voltadas ao desenvolvimento de soluções inteligentes baseadas em dados não estruturados e IA generativa, apoiando desafios estratégicos da organização.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Desenvolver soluções preditivas utilizando métodos clássicos de machine learning , incluindo: Regressão (linear e logística), classificação modelos de séries temporais, arvores de decisão, gradient Boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) e KNN;

Conduzir análises exploratórias completas (EDA), identificando padrões, inconsistências e oportunidades de transformação dos dados;

Executar pré-processamento avançado: limpeza, normalização, encoding, tratamento de outliers e balanceamento;

Selecionar e construir variáveis relevantes (feature engineering), aplicando técnicas estatísticas e conhecimento de negócio;

Implementar modelos preditivos com foco em performance, interpretabilidade e impacto estratégico;

Validar modelos utilizando métricas adequadas, técnicas de cross-validation e tuning de hiperparâmetros;

Atuar diretamente com o cliente, participando de discussões de backlog, refinamento de requisitos e proposição de melhorias técnicas e de processo;

Documentar análises, decisões técnicas e resultados de forma clara e estruturada.



Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência prática com Python aplicado a ciência de dados e machine learning;

Experiência com métodos clássicos de machine learning;

Vivência com Databricks ;

Experiência com plataformas de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP);

Domínio de técnicas de validação de modelos, tuning de hiperparâmetros e métricas de avaliação (AUC, F1, RMSE, MAPE etc.).

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital

Código da oportunidade: 57333


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei , venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Desenvolvedor Salesforce SR


Diferencial: Experiência com Experience Cloud Visão Geral Desenvolvimento de programas e aplicações para as “clouds” da plataforma Salesforce utilizadas pelo cliente, seguindo as boas práticas de desenvolvimento e governança; Testes e implantação das funcionalidades desenvolvidas de acordo com os critérios de aceitação; Realização de demonstrações para usuários finais, trabalhar em conjunto com usuários-chave, arquitetos de solução e consultores de negócio para garantir que as funcionalidades implementadas e a experiência dos usuários atinjam os objetivos definidos.


Responsabilidades

Desenvolver soluções standard ou customizadas com o uso da plataforma Salesforce para suportar funções críticas do negócio, atendendo objetivos de projetos e requerimentos de negócio;

Suporte e manutenção da instância Salesforce Codificação em APEX, Visualforce e Lightning (Aura & LWC) Conhecimento sólido de tecnologias web, tais como JavaScript, HTML5, CSS Controle de versionamento de código (GIT, Bit Bucket, Visual studio. IntelliJ, Outros)

Explorar a configuração do Salesforce OOB para desenvolver o máximo possível das soluções sem codificação

Elaboração de documentação técnica especificando solução a ser implementada em conjunto com protótipos, fluxogramas e diagramas de sequência

Garantir que os planos de testes são criados para atender os requerimentos funcionais, técnicos e de qualidade

Realizar revisões dos desenvolvimentos de outros desenvolvedores Adequação de código aos designs patterns mais consolidados de desenvolvimento: OOP, MVCS, Domain Layer Principle Conhecimentos Técnicos Salesforce Salesforce CRM, Lightning Application, Apex Custom Controllers, Apex Classes, Apex Triggers, Visualforce Pages/Components, Lightning Pages/Components, Apex Web Services, SOQL, SOSL, Workflow and Approvals, Reports and Dashboards, Sharing Settings, Batch Schedule Classes, Test Classes., flows Salesforce Tools Force.com Explorer, Change Sets, Force.com Import Wizard, Force.com Excel Connector, Force.comPlatform (Sandbox and Production), Visual studio. IntelliJ, Inspector Ferramentas de Integração Apex Data Loader, Import Wizard, Data Export, Mass Delete, Integration (Rest), Postman Linguagens: Apex, Java, C, C++, SQL, SOQL, SOSL Salesforce Certification Mandatório - Platform Developer 1, Platform App Builder.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Lead Data Architect – Azure Databricks & Advanced
description:
Lead Data Architect – Azure Databricks & Advanced Analytics


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Lead Data Architect with deep expertise in Azure Databricks and advanced analytics to design and deliver scalable, cloud-native data solutions. This role requires strong hands-on technical skills combined with architectural leadership to drive end-to-end analytics platforms aligned with business objectives.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in big data technologies, data engineering, and Azure cloud services, with a strong focus on Databricks, SQL, and modern data lakehouse architectures.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks and Microsoft Fabric
  • Collaborate closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional IT teams to gather requirements and translate them into effective data solutions
  • Own end-to-end delivery of data platforms, ensuring alignment with business needs, architectural standards, and best practices
  • Design and develop scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes using Azure Databricks, PySpark, and related tools
  • Integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services, including Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory , and on-premise systems
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to data engineering teams, fostering continuous learning and innovation
  • Ensure comprehensive documentation of data architectures, pipelines, and data flows
  • Enforce best practices for code quality, data security, governance, and scalability
  • Stay current with evolving Databricks and Azure technologies to drive continuous improvement and innovation


Essential Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks , including cluster management, notebook development, and Delta Lake
  • Proficiency in big data technologies such as Spark, Hadoop , and data processing frameworks like PySpark
  • Deep understanding of Azure services including Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2), Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory
  • Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines, data lakes, and data warehouses
  • Advanced SQL skills and familiarity with NoSQL databases
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems such as Git
  • Strong knowledge of cloud security and governance best practices


Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues
  • Proven leadership and mentoring skills, with experience leading and guiding data engineering teams


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Power BI for dashboarding and reporting
  • Exposure to Microsoft Fabric for analytics and integration workloads
  • Knowledge of Spark Streaming for real-time data processing
  • Familiarity with Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices


Experience Requirements

  • 12+ years of demonstrated experience in developing data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Databricks, Azure Synapse notebooks, and Azure Data Factory
  • Strong hands-on experience with Delta Tables, Delta Lake, and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2
  • Proven expertise using Auto Loader and Delta Live Tables for efficient data ingestion and transformation
  • Experience building and optimizing query layers using Databricks SQL
  • Demonstrated experience integrating Databricks with Azure Synapse, ADLS Gen2, and Power BI for end-to-end analytics solutions
  • Prior experience developing, optimizing, and deploying Power BI reports
  • Solid understanding of modern CI/CD practices , particularly for Databricks and cloud-native architectures

title: AI Automation Specialist | Ecommerce (Full-time Remote, BR)
description:
Carepod is a growing premium humidifier brand operating in the US, Canada, and Australia . We’re looking for an AI Automation Specialist to eliminate manual work and build smart, reliable workflows across the business.



What You’ll Do


  • Build AI-powered automations for marketing, operation, CS, and reporting system throughout company
  • Connect tools like Shopify, Asana, Google Workspace, Zendesk
  • Design workflows using Zapier / Make / n8n + LLMs like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, etc
  • Identify inefficiencies and turn them into systems



What We’re Looking For


  • 3+ years in automation / ops / systems roles
  • Hands-on experience with no-code / low-code tools
  • Strong business process thinking
  • Clear English communication
  • Bonus: ecommerce, Python, security-minded builds



How to Apply


  • Apply with your resume or LinkedIn profile.

title: SAP Mobile Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Work as part of SAP Empowered Product Teams, design, develop, and maintain frontend application features for cross platform mobile SAP Service and Asset Manager.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of standard and SAP mobile technology in development and testing, such as SAP BTP Mobile Services, SAP Mobile Development Kit, JavaScript, TypeScript, Visual Studio Code, Xcode, Android Studio, ilodata, SQL, Ultralite DB, Appium, Java, SAP Business Application Studio, Github, CI/CD with Hyperspace Fastlane, OData Services, SAP Gateway, S/4HANA system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, feature requirement

Actively collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines for each platform, iOS, Android and Windows, and figma design for the application.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with backend integration service developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration in frontend logic

Use S/4HANA system and its relevant business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), and data objects (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), setup necessary test data in S/4HANA system, perform end-to-end test, and validate developed features against S/4HANA system.

Conduct thorough testing, including unit testing, integration test, and UI automation test scripts for developed features

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, crashes, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead MDK developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Work as part of SAP Empowered Product Teams, design, develop, and maintain frontend application features for cross platform mobile SAP Service and Asset Manager.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of standard and SAP mobile technology in development and testing, such as SAP BTP Mobile Services, SAP Mobile Development Kit, JavaScript, TypeScript, Visual Studio Code, Xcode, Android Studio, ilodata, SQL, Ultralite DB, Appium, Java, SAP Business Application Studio, Github, CI/CD with Hyperspace Fastlane, OData Services, SAP Gateway, S/4HANA system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, feature requirement

Actively collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines for each platform, iOS, Android and Windows, and figma design for the application.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with backend integration service developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration in frontend logic

Use S/4HANA system and its relevant business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), and data objects (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), setup necessary test data in S/4HANA system, perform end-to-end test, and validate developed features against S/4HANA system.

Conduct thorough testing, including unit testing, integration test, and UI automation test scripts for developed features

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, crashes, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead MDK developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Sobre a área: O escritório de projetos atua na padronização de processos de governanç arelacionados ag estão de projetos, facilitando o compartilhamento de reports, metodologias, ferramentas e técnicas para alcançar o desafio deimplementar iniciativas com sucesso. Principais atividades:


  • Entender com profundidade o projeto que será trabalhado, com enfoque no valor que será gerado;
  • Agir em conformidade à metodologia estabelecida pelo Escritório de Projetos (PMO), ser um administrador diligente, respeitoso e atencioso;
  • Apoiar o superior imediato em assuntos inerentes à sua área de atuação, apresentando e discutindosoluções para problemas e irregularidades, a fim de subsidiar a definição de ações a serem adotadas eauxiliar na busca pelo melhoramento contínuo dos processos da área;
  • Criar um ambiente colaborativo para a equipe de projeto;
  • Mapear e envolver stakeholders;
  • Otimizar as respostas aos riscos;
  • Adequar o projeto de acordo com o contexto, adotando uma capacidade de adaptação e resiliência;
  • Realizar acompanhamento ativo de pendências;
  • Incluir critérios de aceitação nas entregas para garantia da qualidade e atendimento de expectativas
  • Executar outras tarefas correlatas, do mesmo grau de dificuldade mediante solicitação do superiorimediato


Buscamos alguém que apresente:


  • Pacote Office – intermediário
  • MS Project – básico
  • Métodos ágeis – básico
  • Experiência prévia na condução de projetos de diferentes portes e complexidades
  • Superior Completo (Administração, Engenharia, TI ou áreas correlatas)?MBA em Gestão de Projetos (desejável)


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito

  • Carga Horária: 44h Semanais
  • Escala: Segunda a sexta - feira
  • Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Software
description:
Somos uma empresa de tecnologia criada para transformar o mercado de serviços financeiros no Brasil e na América Latina. Estamos crescendo rápido, integrando novos negócios, acelerando inovação e construindo com intenção e consistência a cultura que sustentará nosso futuro.

Cultura, para nós, não é discurso: é sistema, prática e forma de operar.

E agora buscamos alguém que venha construir isso junto.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


SUA MISSÃO:

A pessoa coordenadora atua como uma ponte entre a estratégia macro e a execução, garantindo que os times de Product Owners/Managers, Frontend e Backend tenham os recursos, a orientação e o ambiente necessários para entregar valor constante ao negócio.

Seu principal foco será o desenvolvimento de talentos, excelência operacional e entrega tática.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

• Gestão de Pessoas: Liderar, mentorar e desenvolver a equipe, realizando 1:1s, planos de desenvolvimento individual (PDI) e avaliações de desempenho.

• Alinhamento Tático: Garantir que as squads sob sua coordenação estejam alinhadas com os

OKRs da área e que as dependências entre times sejam gerenciadas com eficiência.

• Refinamento de Processos: Implementar e otimizar metodologias de discovery e delivery, garantindo agilidade e qualidade sem burocracia excessiva.

• Interface com Stakeholders: Atuar como ponto de apoio para áreas parceiras (Vendas, CX,

Engenharia), traduzindo prioridades e gerenciando expectativas de curto e médio prazo.

• Suporte ao Discovery: Apoiar o time na validação de hipóteses e na construção de roadmaps realistas e baseados em dados.


O QUE ESPERAMOS QUE VOCÊ SAIBA:

• Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor; domínio de metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban); conhecimento em métricas de produto (NPS, Churn, LTV, conversão); experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Notion, etc.).

• Liderança servidora, habilidade em resolução de conflitos, comunicação clara e assertiva, capacidade de dar e receber feedbacks construtivos e organização multitarefa.

• Conhecimento básico em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação para backend nas linguagens Ruby on Rails, Java, C#, Node.js, Python, PHP.

• Noções de bancos de dados relacionais e linguagem SQL (ex: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL

Server).

Conhecimento básico sobre o funcionamento de APis REST.

• Domínio de um framework (React, Vue, Angular) e seu ecossistema.

• Profundo conhecimento em gerenciamento de estado (Redux, Vuex, Zustand, etc.).

• Experiência sólida com ferramentas de build (Webpack, Vite) e pré-processadores

(SASS).

• Habilidade em criar e manter testes automatizados (Jest, Cypress).

• ¡OS Nativo (Swift):

• Domínio de padrões de arquitetura (MVVM, VIPER).

• Profundo conhecimento em SwiftUl e/ou UIKit para layouts complexos.

• Experiência com gerenciamento de dependências (Swift Package Manager, CocoaPods) e concorrência (GCD, Swift Concurrency).

• Android Nativo (Kotlin):

• Domínio de padrões de arquitetura (MVVM, MVI) e dos componentes Jetpack.

• Profundo conhecimento em Jetpack Compose e/ou XML para layouts complexos.

• Experiência com Coroutines/Flow para programação assíncrona e Dagger/Hilt para injeção de dependência.

• Flutter (Dart):

• Domínio de padrões de gerenciamento de estado avançados (BLoC, Riverpod).

• Habilidade em criar widgets customizados e complexos.

• Experiência com canais de plataforma (platform channels) para integração com código nativo.

• Mentalidade Orientada a Dados: Capacidade de tomar decisões baseadas em evidências.

• Empatia pelo Cliente: Um desejo profundo de entender e resolver os problemas dos usuários.

• Espírito Colaborativo: Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe com desenvolvedores, designers, marketing e outras áreas.

• Resiliência e Adaptação: Capacidade de navegar em ambientes de incerteza e mudar de curso

quando necessário.


O Que Oferecemos:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Desenvolvedor Java Back-end
description:
Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Back-end Java para atuar em um ambiente de alta criticidade , com foco em integrações, mensageria e microsserviços , participando ativamente do desenvolvimento de soluções robustas e escaláveis.


Stack Tecnológico

Obrigatório:

  • Java 11+;
  • Spring Boot;
  • APIs REST;
  • RabbitMQ;
  • MongoDB;
  • Oracle.

Desejável:

  • Kafka;
  • Redis;
  • Docker;
  • Kubernetes / OpenShift;
  • Observabilidade (Datadog, AppDynamics, ELK).

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Criar e consumir filas RabbitMQ (listeners para eventos de renovação e cancelamento).
  • Implementar integrações REST com sistemas como BCP, Bureau, Dossiê, Sinistro e Vistoria Prévia.
  • Desenvolver endpoints para geração de ofertas APA / AFI.
  • Realizar manutenção e ajustes em tabelas Oracle.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de Clean Code, SOLID e Design Patterns.
  • Participar de code reviews e pair programming.
  • Garantir cobertura de testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito).

Requisitos Técnicos

Obrigatórios:

  • 3+ anos de experiência com Java e Spring Boot em produção.
  • Experiência sólida com microsserviços e APIs REST.
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (RabbitMQ ou Kafka).
  • Domínio de bancos relacionais (Oracle/PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB).
  • Versionamento de código com Git / GitLab.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Kubernetes / OpenShift.
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade e monitoramento.
  • Certificação Oracle Certified Professional.

title: Brazil - Remote: Tech Lead
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the \"Control Room\" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s \"Visualizations\" and that the \"Data Pipelines\" are reliably deployed by DevOps.


What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The \"Expert\": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.


Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.


Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud


Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.


Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.


Location

Fully Remote position.


Job Details

Requisition Number:

Experience Level: Mid to Senior

Job Family: Engineering/Science/Technology

Product Service Line: Landmark Software & Services

Full Time / Part Time: Full Time

Employee Group: Temporary
